description: Delegation depth violation: the implementation permits at most 3 agent-to-agent delegation edges (A→B→C→D is valid). D delegates to E, creating a 4th edge that exceeds the configured depth limit. NOTE: Annam's AV-07 has two attack variants — depth-limit exceeded (covered here) and loop/repeated-element (A→B→C→B, not yet covered).

rule.name: INV-01_delegation_depth
rule.description: A delegation chain must not exceed the configured maximum delegation depth

action.reason: delegation chain depth exceeds the configured maximum (INV-01 depth/loop safety)
